recursive_gen_depth_est\\n\\n> 非 metrics 性质的决策原因、约束、经验教训。Metrics 查 registry。\\n\\n## 决策原因\\n\\n- **CORAL 需要充分训练**: epochs=5 只得 53.7%，100 epochs 后 78.1%。d1v2 AUC 从 0.34→0.82。之前\\\"CORAL 不适合此任务\\\"的结论是训练不足导致的误判。(2026-05-14)\\n- **CE-MLP 可能也训练不足**: baseline battery 首次跑 CE-MLP 用了 5 epochs 得 74.9%，需要用默认参数重跑确认。(2026-05-14)\\n- **解码策略影响是模型依赖的 (D006, updated)**: Pythia temp09 降 1.9pp，但 GPT-2 XL temp09 升 2.1pp，OLMo temp09 升 3.26pp。论文不能说\\\"strategy-agnostic\\\"，应说\\\"strategy-dependent magnitude with consistent signal presence\\\"。(2026-05-15)\\n- **OLMo temp09 是当前最强配置 (D008)**: 82.03% 4-class RF, d1v2 AUC 0.901。(2026-05-15)\\n- **Feature importance 表述 (D007)**: top feature set (p90_ppl, var_surprisal) 跨 cells 稳定，但 ranking 因模型而异。Claim 2 应说\\\"consistent feature set\\\"而非\\\"var_surprisal as single best\\\"。(2026-05-14)\\n- **Top-k 信号衰减**: Pythia top-k 69.6% vs nucleus 78.2% (-8.6pp)，截断式采样比连续概率重分配保留更弱的深度信号。(2026-05-14)\\n- **Atlas v2 EDD 差异 (D009)**: 6/7 cells EDD=3，但 Pythia topk50 EDD=1（d2v3 AUC=0.692）。\\\"小模型+受限采样→退化信号更早饱和\\\"是 Discussion 核心论点。(2026-05-15)\\n- **Atlas v2 Feature trajectory (D010)**: p90_ppl/var_surprisal/mean_surprisal 随 depth 单调递减（ρ=-1.0），rep_2gram/3gram/4gram 随 depth 单调递增。两类信号互补。(2026-05-15)\\n- **EDD 推荐阈值 T=0.75 (D011)**: T=0.75 下 7/9 维持 EDD=3，仅 topk 掉队。瓶颈统一在 d2v3 pair。(2026-05-15)\\n- **topk 跨模型一致性最高 (D012)**: ρ=0.811，确定性截断使 feature landscape 趋同，但伴随信号衰减。(2026-05-15)\\n- **p90_ppl 优于 mean_ppl 的统计根因**: 1 个样本 (mean_ppl=1.43e13) 贡献 depth-1 mean_ppl 的 94.4%。Token-level perplexity 极度重尾（kurtosis>4900）。p90_ppl 完美单调。论文应说明 percentile-based features 的统计稳健性优势。(2026-05-15)\\n- **Cross-strategy LOO temp09 d1v2 反转根因 (D014, updated)**: Covariate shift 确认。temp09 depth N ≈ 其他策略 depth N+1。z-score 后 GPT-2 XL 0.13→0.68, OLMo 0.25→0.83。机制：temperature \\\"tail narrowing\\\"（Dohmatob et al.）vs nucleus/topk \\\"tail cutting\\\"——均匀压缩 vs 截断，导致不同收敛速率。论文 Discussion 写 \\\"accelerated convergence\\\"。**⚠️ z-score 修复依赖分类器类型**：LR 受益（0.13→0.68），RF 完全不变（树模型对特征线性缩放不变，z-score 不改变排序/分裂点）。论文不能笼统说 \\\"z-score fixes the inversion\\\"，需区分 classifier。(2026-05-15)\\n- **Cross-model LOO 3-class (plan_005 detailed)**: mean acc 55.4%，d2 recall 最低 (0.409)——d2 夹在 d1/d3 之间最难区分，符合 ordinal structure 预期。(2026-05-15)\\n\\n## DCOL 系统性失败分析 (2026-05-15)\\n\\nv1-v5 全部失败（embedding collapse / OOM / catastrophic forgetting / NaN）。根因：DeBERTa disentangled attention 与 contrastive loss 数值不兼容。v6 换用 RoBERTa-large。Framing: DCOL 降级为 negative analysis section (D011)。\\n\\n## 文献调研 (2026-05-15)\\n\\n**解码策略效应**（partially-known，我们的应用场景是新的）：\\n1. Garces Arias et al. (COLING 2025) \\\"Decoding Decoded\\\" — 最优解码配置因模型而异\\n2. Wiher, Meister & Cotterell (TACL 2022) — 解码策略效应 task-dependent\\n3. Holtzman et al. (ICLR 2020) — nucleus sampling 奠基\\n4. Shumailov et al. (Nature 2024) — 递归生成导致模型坍塌（但未比较采样策略）\\n5. Basu et al. - **Cross-strategy LOO temp09 d1v2 反转根因 (D014, updated)**: Covariate shift 确认。temp09 depth N ≈ 其他策略 depth N+1。z-score 后 GPT-2 XL 0.13→0.68, OLMo 0.25→0.83。机制：temperature "tail narrowing"（Dohmatob et al.）vs nucleus/topk "tail cutting"——均匀压缩 vs 截断，导致不同收敛速率。论文 Discussion 写 "accelerated convergence"。**⚠️ z-score 修复依赖分类器类型**：LR 受益（0.13→0.68），RF 完全不变（树模型对特征线性缩放不变，z-score 不改变排序/分裂点）。论文不能笼统说 "z-score fixes the inversion"，需区分 classifier。(2026-05-15)

v1-v5 全部失败（embedding collapse / OOM / catastrophic forgetting / NaN）。根因：DeBERTa disentangled attention 与 contrastive loss 数值不兼容。v6 换用 RoBERTa-large。Framing: DCOL 降级为 negative analysis section (D011)。

## 文献调研 (2026-05-15)

**解码策略效应**（partially-known，我们的应用场景是新的）：
1. Garces Arias et al. (COLING 2025) "Decoding Decoded" — 最优解码配置因模型而异
2. Wiher, Meister & Cotterell (TACL 2022) — 解码策略效应 task-dependent
3. Holtzman et al. (ICLR 2020) — nucleus sampling 奠基
4. Shumailov et al. (Nature 2024) — 递归生成导致模型坍塌（但未比较采样策略）
5. Basu et al. (ICLR 2021) "Mirostat" — perplexity 与采样参数非线性关系

**Covariate shift 机制支撑**（补充调研 2026-05-15）：
6. **Dohmatob et al. (ICML 2024)** — "tail narrowing" (temperature, q∝i^{-β/T}) vs "tail cutting" (nucleus/topk)。直接解释我们的 ~1 depth 偏移
7. **Marchi et al. (ICASSP 2025)** — T<1 放大概率差异 → 加速 mode collapse。最强理论支撑
8. **Drayson et al. (EMNLP 2025)** — τ=0.9 在 99 代递归中多样性下降 70%，困惑度退化更温和。最强实证
- 新颖性：①量化 ~1 depth 偏移 ②covariate shift 框架化 ③z-score 修正方法 均为新贡献

- **`edd_analysis_9cell.json`**: 系统性偏高 ~+0.03，**论文不引用**

v1-v5 全部失败（embedding collapse / OOM / catastrophic forgetting / NaN）。根因：DeBERTa disentangled attention 与 contrastive loss 数值不兼容。v6 换用 RoBERTa-large，解决了稳定性问题（无 NaN/collapse），但 test acc=64.5% 远低于 RF baseline 78.2% (-13.7pp)。严重过拟合（train 75% vs val 64.4%），early stopping epoch 4。**DCOL 方向彻底关闭**——contrastive ordinal loss 对此任务表达能力不足，不是 backbone 问题。Framing: DCOL 降级为 negative analysis section (D011)，为论文增加一个"what doesn't work"的分析维度。

## 文献调研 (2026-05-15)

**解码策略效应**（partially-known，我们的应用场景是新的）：
1. Garces Arias et al. (COLING 2025) "Decoding Decoded" — 最优解码配置因模型而异
2. Wiher, Meister & Cotterell (TACL 2022) — 解码策略效应 task-dependent
3. Holtzman et al. (ICLR 2020) — nucleus sampling 奠基
4. Shumailov et al. (Nature 2024) — 递归生成导致模型坍塌（但未比较采样策略）
5. Basu et al. (ICLR 2021) "Mirostat" — perplexity 与采样参数非线性关系

**Covariate shift 机制支撑**（补充调研 2026-05-15）：
6. **Dohmatob et al. (ICML 2024)** — "tail narrowing" (temperature, q∝i^{-β/T}) vs "tail cutting" (nucleus/topk)。直接解释我们的 ~1 depth 偏移
7. **Marchi et al. (ICASSP 2025)** — T<1 放大概率差异 → 加速 mode collapse。最强理论支撑
8. **Drayson et al. (EMNLP 2025)** — τ=0.9 在 99 代递归中多样性下降 70%，困惑度退化更温和。最强实证
- 新颖性：①量化 ~1 depth 偏移 ②covariate shift 框架化 ③z-score 修正方法 均为新贡献

## AUC 数据源统一 + Reconciliation (2026-05-15)

- **pipeline `pairwise_auc.json`** = ground truth
- **`edd_sensitivity.json`**: 9/9 cells 已与 pipeline 一致，可安全引用
- **`edd_analysis_9cell.json`**: 系统性偏高 ~+0.03，**论文不引用**
- **`plot_atlas_figures.py`**: 已重构为从 pipeline JSON 动态加载
- **Reconciliation**: pipeline↔edd_sensitivity 27/27 一致，pipeline↔registry 41/41 一致，EDD 全部一致
- ⚠️ **baseline_battery_9cell_001 字段命名陷阱**：`best_acc_matrix_rf` 实际存的是所有方法最优 accuracy，非纯 RF。olmo_topk50 差 2.2pp。论文引用 RF 必须用各 cell 独立 registry

## 约束

- Qwen2.5 系列代码占比过高，LoRA 无法覆盖，已验证不可用
- 根分区 ~30GB，模型/数据必须在 `/root/autodl-tmp/`
- OLMo 必须用 `olmo-1b-hf` 目录（不是 `olmo-1b`）
- DCOL margin_lr 不能超过 1e-4（1e-3 导致 embedding collapse）
- OLMo cron 监控有 false failure 风险（子进程 PID vs pipeline 主进程）
- DeBERTa disentangled attention 与 contrastive loss 数值不兼容

## 经验教训

- kill 实验时必须 `ps -p PID` + `nvidia-smi` 验证进程确实死亡
- 僵尸进程会导致后续实验 OOM
- conda 环境不要混用 pip install，统一用一种
- sync_code 前确保本地 commit 已 push
- Baseline epochs 参数很重要——默认值通常比手动设的小值好得多
- DCOL 类 contrastive ordinal loss 对 backbone 数值稳定性要求极高
- submit_training_job 可能不自动转 RUNNING（需手动 update_registry 推进状态）
- DCOL 即使解决稳定性问题（RoBERTa 替代 DeBERTa），准确率仍远低于简单 RF baseline——问题不在 backbone 而在 loss function 对此任务的适配性

Garces Arias et al. (COLING 2025) \\\"Decoding Decoded\\\" — 最优解码配置因模型而异\\n2. Wiher, Meister & Cotterell (TACL 2022) — 解码策略效应 task-dependent\\n3. Holtzman et al. (ICLR 2020) — nucleus sampling 奠基\\n4. Shumailov et al. (Nature 2024) — 递归生成导致模型坍塌（但未比较采样策略）\\n5. Basu et al. (ICLR 2021) \\\"Mirostat\\\" — perplexity 与采样参数非线性关系\\n\\n**Covariate shift 机制支撑**（补充调研 2026-05-15）：\\n6. **Dohmatob et al. (ICML 2024)** — \\\"tail narrowing\\\" (temperature, q∝i^{-β/T}) vs \\\"tail cutting\\\" (nucleus/topk)。直接解释我们的 ~1 depth 偏移\\n7. **Marchi et al. from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/recursive_gen_depth_est")

FEATURE_COLS = [
    "mean_ppl", "var_ppl", "skewness_ppl", "kurtosis_ppl",
    "p10_ppl", "p25_ppl", "p50_ppl", "p75_ppl", "p90_ppl",
    "mean_surprisal", "var_surprisal", "entropy_of_surprisal",
    "type_token_ratio", "hapax_ratio",
    "bigram_entropy", "trigram_entropy",
    "rep_2gram", "rep_3gram", "rep_4gram",
]


def load_features(path):
    X, y = [], []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            rec = json.loads(line)
            feats = [rec[c] for c in FEATURE_COLS]
            if not any(np.isnan(feats) | np.isinf(feats)):
                X.append(feats)
                y.append(rec["depth"])
    return np.array(X), np.array(y)


def find_and_load_all_features():
    """Search for features files covering depths 0-5."""
    candidates = [
        BASE / "results" / "depth_extension" / "features_all.jsonl",
        BASE / "results" / "depth_extension" / "features_6class.jsonl",
        BASE / "data" / "features_all_6class.jsonl",
    ]
    for c in candidates:
        if c.exists():
            print(f"Found combined features: {c}")
            return load_features(c)

    # Fallback: combine original d0-d3 + extension d4-d5
    print("No combined file found, assembling from individual sources...")
    X_all, y_all = [], []

    # d0-d3 from original pipeline
    orig = BASE / "data" / "features_all.jsonl"
    if orig.exists():
        X, y = load_features(orig)
        print(f"  Original features_all.jsonl: {len(X)} samples, depths {np.unique(y)}")
        X_all.append(X)
        y_all.append(y)

    # d4, d5 from depth extension
    for d in [4, 5]:
        for pattern in [
            BASE / "results" / "depth_extension" / f"features_depth_{d}.jsonl",
            BASE / "results" / "depth_extension" / f"depth_{d}_features.jsonl",
            BASE / "data" / f"features_depth_{d}.jsonl",
            BASE / "data" / f"depth_{d}_features.jsonl",
        ]:
            if pattern.exists():
                X, y = load_features(pattern)
                print(f"  Depth {d}: {len(X)} samples from {pattern}")
                X_all.append(X)
                y_all.append(y)
                break
        else:
            print(f"  WARNING: No features found for depth {d}")

    if not X_all:
        return np.array([]), np.array([])
    return np.vstack(X_all), np.concatenate(y_all)


def binary_rf_eval(X, y, d_low, d_high, seed=42, n_bootstrap=1000):
    mask = np.isin(y, [d_low, d_high])
    Xb = X[mask]
    yb = (y[mask] == d_high).astype(int)

    print(f"\n{'='*50}")
    print(f"Binary d{d_low}v{d_high}: {len(yb)} samples "
          f"(class0={np.sum(yb==0)}, class1={np.sum(yb==1)})")

    X_tr, X_te, y_tr, y_te = train_test_split(
        Xb, yb, test_size=0.2, stratify=yb, random_state=seed
    )
    rf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500, random_state=seed, n_jobs=-1)
    rf.fit(X_tr, y_tr)

    y_prob = rf.predict_proba(X_te)[:, 1]
    y_pred = rf.predict(X_te)
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_te, y_prob)
    acc = accuracy_score(y_te, y_pred)
    prec = precision_score(y_te, y_pred)
    rec = recall_score(y_te, y_pred)

    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    aucs = []
    for _ in range(n_bootstrap):
        idx = rng.choice(len(y_te), len(y_te), replace=True)
        if len(np.unique(y_te[idx])) == 2:
            aucs.append(roc_auc_score(y_te[idx], y_prob[idx]))
    ci_lo, ci_hi = np.percentile(aucs, [2.5, 97.5])

    fi = rf.feature_importances_
    top5_idx = np.argsort(fi)[::-1][:5]
    top5 = [(FEATURE_COLS[i], round(float(fi[i]), 4)) for i in top5_idx]

    result = {
        "pair": f"d{d_low}v{d_high}",
        "auc": round(float(auc), 4),
        "auc_ci95": [round(float(ci_lo), 4), round(float(ci_hi), 4)],
        "accuracy": round(float(acc), 4),
        "precision": round(float(prec), 4),
        "recall": round(float(rec), 4),
        "n_train": int(len(y_tr)),
        "n_test": int(len(y_te)),
        "top5_features": top5,
    }

    print(f"  AUC:  {auc:.4f} [{ci_lo:.4f}, {ci_hi:.4f}]")
    print(f"  Acc:  {acc:.4f}  Prec: {prec:.4f}  Rec: {rec:.4f}")
    print(f"  Top5: {top5}")
    return result


def main():
    X, y = find_and_load_all_features()
    if len(X) == 0:
        print("ERROR: No features loaded.")
        print("Listing potential directories:")
        for d in ["results/depth_extension", "data", "results"]:
            p = BASE / d
            if p.exists():
                files = list(p.glob("*.jsonl"))
                print(f"  {p}: {[f.name for f in files]}")
        sys.exit(1)

    depths_found = dict(zip(*np.unique(y, return_counts=True)))
    print(f"\nTotal: {len(X)} samples, depths: {depths_found}")

    # Run binary RF for d1v2, d2v3 (sanity check) + d3v4, d4v5 (target)
    results = {}
    for d_low, d_high in [(1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 4), (4, 5)]:
        if d_low in depths_found and d_high in depths_found:
            results[f"d{d_low}v{d_high}"] = binary_rf_eval(X, y, d_low, d_high)
        else:
            print(f"\nWARNING: Skipping d{d_low}v{d_high} — depth not in data")

    # EDD determination
    d3v4_auc = results.get("d3v4", {}).get("auc", 0)
    d4v5_auc = results.get("d4v5", {}).get("auc", 0)
    if d3v4_auc > 0.75 and d4v5_auc > 0.75:
        edd = ">=5"
    elif d3v4_auc > 0.75:
        edd = "4"
    else:
        edd = "3"

    print(f"\n{'='*50}")
    print(f"EDD DETERMINATION: d3v4={d3v4_auc:.4f}, d4v5={d4v5_auc:.4f} → EDD {edd}")

    # Reference: 4-class pipeline pairwise AUC (Pythia nucleus)
    ref = {"d0v1": 0.9975, "d1v2": 0.8607, "d2v3": 0.8005}
    print(f"\nSanity check vs 4-class pipeline:")
    for pair in ["d1v2", "d2v3"]:
        if pair in results:
            delta = results[pair]["auc"] - ref[pair]
            print(f"  {pair}: binary={results[pair]['auc']:.4f} vs 4-class={ref[pair]:.4f} (Δ={delta:+.4f})")

    # Save
    out_dir = BASE / "results" / "binary_pairwise"
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output = {
        "pairs": results,
        "edd_determination": edd,
        "threshold": 0.75,
        "reference_4class": ref,
    }
    out_path = out_dir / "binary_pairwise_results.json"
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(output, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nResults saved to {out_path}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
